title: Fungiculture (mushrooms)
description: A small mod that brings a bit of mushrooms into your world!
body:
_Currently, this mod adds 3 mushroom species._

This mod is, also, in Alpha version. Expect changes!



This mod ands fungi to Minecraft and a new Mushroomer villager profession


![You can find mushrooms all around the forest biomes.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77d56ce73e99ef84c1e10cb0812a9fce2d9e7cbf.png)
_You can find mushrooms all around the forest biomes._

![Mushroomer Table Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10fec37e8adc55d6441368ddf4b30691f672cd6f.png)

Then there is the Mushroomer Table! Which is made with 6 dark oak planks and 3 white mushrooms



If you place it near the villager, they will become the Mushroomer! Currently, the mushroomers don't spawn naturally in villages. I may fix that eventually.
![Mushroomer trading window](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62eb3051dd7dc60f6c335bdc3f05ad6bb88b70d1.png)
You can buy or sell mushrooms to the mushroomer!
